profile.org_note: Family-owned, three generations: Park Square Enterprises, LLC is the parent of Park Square Homes, Kimaya (commercial, multifamily and build-to-rent development), PSH Mortgage (JV with FBC Mortgage) and Park Square Homes Title. Co-CEOs Suresh Gupta and son Vishaal Gupta run it; Keith Hurand was named President and COO in July 2024 (not reconfirmed in 2026). Finance sits with CFO Monika Goyal (shared with Kimaya); land acquisition and development are run by a small in-house team at manager level (no current VP of Land is publicly named, and the company has advertised the VP of Land seat).
profile.summary: Orlando-based, family-owned Florida-only builder founded in 1984, ranked No. 100 on the 2026 Builder 100 with 522 closings and $251M revenue in 2025, down from 996 closings and $311M in 2024. It builds entry-level single-family homes and townhomes across Central Florida, Tampa Bay and Southwest Florida, plus 6-15 bedroom vacation and short-term-rental resort homes near the Orlando parks, and its sister company Kimaya develops build-to-rent and multifamily (Park Square Homes acted as general contractor on Kimaya's award-winning Ocoee Village build-to-rent townhomes). It buys both raw land it develops itself and finished lots from developers, which makes it a plausible, if small, lot-option customer.
